messages:
Priya Shah: Lumenix sent back the RFI with three escalation points: EU data egress, Dedicated commit pricing, and canary rollout guarantees. They also attached a spreadsheet. I uploaded their file: lumenix_rfi_questions_v3.xlsx. Can we assign?
Ethan Cole: I'll take pricing & commit tiers. Do we have standard 1/2/3-year discounts for Dedicated?
Nina Park: I'll take security and data residency. Quick note: they want 180-day audit log retention (longer than our default). Can we do that for Dedicated?
Jordan Lee: I can handle rollout and ops answers (canaries/A-B). Also check model quantization support question.
rfi-bot: File uploaded: lumenix_rfi_questions_v3.xlsx (by Priya Shah)
Ethan Cole: Pricing note: standard Dedicated tiers are monthly commit with sliding discounts: 10% (small), 18% (medium), 28% (large) off on-hosted list for equivalent capacity. For 100 qps sustained we likely recommend Dedicated medium (3x A100 equiv). Proposed PoC: 25% off hosted for 3 months or a 30-day Dedicated pilot at pro-rated monthly.
Priya Shah: Lumenix specifically asked about egress fees from EU regions when connecting to US backups. Nina, can Dedicated instances be constrained to EU-only egress?
Nina Park: yes Dedicated and Private can be deployed in EU regions and we can restrict outbound routes. For backups to US we can add an exception but that will be visible in contract and may incur egress fees. We can estimate egress: typically $0.02/GB outbound depending on cloud. We'll include an example calc.
Jordan Lee: For canary rollouts: we support percentage-based traffic splits per-route with automatic rollback on error/rate thresholds. Suggest text: "Redwood Dedicated supports staged rollouts (canary/A-B) with metrics-based rollback and route-level percent split; latency & error SLOs monitored during rollout." Thoughts?
Priya Shah: add note that model variant fallback occurs if canary fails and traffic automatically shifts to last healthy variant. Lumenix asked about retaining input traces for debugging 180 days?
Nina Park: Input traces retention is configurable. Default 90 days, Dedicated can extend to 180 days for audit at additional cost. We'll propose 180 days for the PoC period then reassess.
Ethan Cole: Pricing table I'll add: hosted per-token baseline, Dedicated commit tiers (monthly commit, unit rate), Private one-time license + monthly infra ops. I'll include an example for 100 qps sustained (estimated token/sec, cost per million tokens).
Jordan Lee: model quantization: we support INT8 and FP16 paths; recommend INT8 for throughput-sensitive workloads; note on quality regression monitoring and Redwood Optimize suggestions. Include snippet: `recommend_quant(profile="latency", target_qps=100) -> INT8, batch=8`.
Priya Shah: legal asked about data deletion SLA and proof of deletion for backups. Nina: can we provide a deletion letter for Private/Dedicated?
Nina Park: yes we can provide deletion confirmation and key shredding proof for customer-managed keys. For cloud backups, deletion timelines depend on provider snapshot retention (we'll include process & example timelines).
Ethan Cole: they also want a commitment on latency p50/p95 at 50 and 100 QPS. Jordan: can ops provide expected numbers for medium pool?
Jordan Lee: estimate: p50 ~ 45-60ms per token, p95 ~ 180-220ms for typical 2k context gen on medium Dedicated with INT8. I'll caveat these are workload dependent and propose a perf run during PoC (3-day perf window).
Priya Shah: attachments we should send back: lumenix_rfi_responses_v1.docx, lumenix_capability_matrix_v2.csv, lumenix_poc_sow_draft.pdf. I'll upload when ready.
Ethan Cole: I'll draft the pricing and SOW bullets. Proposed PoC runbook: Week1 integration + Week2 perf (10M tokens) + Week3 tuning. Recommend a refundable pilot deposit to reserve GPUs.
Nina Park: security answers by 2pm: include SOC2 + ISO27001, customer-managed KMS support, HSM via PKCS#11, SIEM forwarding, and 180-day retention option for Dedicated.
rfi-bot: File uploaded: lumenix_capability_matrix_v2.csv (by Priya Shah)
Jordan Lee: small ops note for the canary text: mention "route-level circuit breaker" and example threshold: errors > 1% for 2 minutes triggers rollback.
Priya Shah: good. Can we finalize and send consolidated packet by EOD? AE wants to present tomorrow.
Ethan Cole: yes, pricing + SOW by 5pm.
Nina Park: security doc + deletion workflow by 4pm.
Jordan Lee: ops + perf numbers by 3:30pm. Sync at 3:10pm quick huddle?
Priya Shah: 3:10 works. Thanks team. :rocket:
